papers.title_en: AOV-GS: Active Open-Vocabulary Semantic Mapping with 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Rodion Shkokov, Tatiana Zemskova, Dmitry Yudin
papers.tldr: 机器人建图需兼顾几何导航与开放词汇语义查询，但现有主动建图或只追求覆盖、语义被动，或依赖监督分割。AOV-GS以冻结SAM/CLIP引导主动探索，用实例掩码嵌入新颖性重排候选视角，并离线拟合场景语言场支持文本查询分割。在Replica和Matterport3D上，其语言场mIoU较仅几何规划提升1.3和1.8个百分点，CorrCLIP下Replica达35.6%。该方法在不依赖人工掩码下提升主动语义建图效率与开放词汇查询能力。
papers.abstract_en: Robots deployed in human-centered environments need maps that support both geometric navigation and open-vocabulary semantic queries beyond a fixed label set. A key challenge is enriching such maps with semantic information without relying on manually annotated segmentation masks or closed-set semantic categories. Existing geometry-driven active mapping maximizes coverage but treats semantics as a passive by-product of the collected trajectory, whereas active semantic mapping typically depends on supervised semantic segmentation. We present AOV-GS, an active 3D Gaussian mapping system that guides exploration using frozen foundation models. During coarse exploration, AOV-GS re-ranks geometrically promising candidate views according to CLIP mask-embedding novelty computed from SAM instance segmentation, biasing exploration toward semantically informative regions. Frozen SAM and CLIP provide instance masks and language-aligned embeddings throughout mapping, while a lightweight scene-specific language field is fitted offline directly to the collected CLIP embeddings rather than manually annotated masks, enabling open-vocabulary text-query segmentation on novel views. In a controlled comparison using the same SAM-CLIP perception stack, AOV-GS improves average language-field mIoU over geometry-only active planning by 1.3 percentage points on Replica (34.6% on eight scenes) and by 1.8 points on Matterport3D (23.1% on five scenes). With CorrCLIP, AOV-GS reaches 35.6% on Replica, 2.0 points above the matched Geometry-based + CorrCLIP baseline. Novel-view PSNR remains comparable to the geometry-only baseline on both datasets while depth L1 improves on Replica. Code is available at https://github.com/OptimusFaber/AOV-GS.

papers.title_en: AirPlayground: Benchmarking Aerial Navigation across Diverse Reconstructed Environments
papers.authors: Rangya Zhang, Yujing Shang, Zhuoyuan Yu, Mingsheng Li, Qingsong Yan, Chao Yan, Yuhang Zhang, Mir Feroskhan
papers.evidence: 面向导航基准的航拍三维高斯泼溅环境
papers.tldr: 现有空中导航资源缺少密集飞行示范与覆盖多环境的标准化闭环评测。AirPlayground构建94个含碰撞几何的3DGS真实感环境，自动采集9.4万条示范和4650万同步样本，并提供统一训练评测API。其在三类场景、七种基线中验证，ACT训练场景从5扩至70使已见/未见环境成功率中位数由30.6%/16.8%升至41.2%/29.4%。该基准支持分析离线预测误差与闭环表现关系。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale aerial resources provide a foundation for learning navigation across diverse environments. However, existing resources remain limited in providing (1) densely sampled flight demonstrations for learning different policy formulations and (2) broad environment coverage for standardized closed-loop evaluation. To address these limitations, we introduce AirPlayground, a unified benchmark for training and evaluating aerial navigation policies across diverse environments. We first construct 94 photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) environments spanning indoor, urban outdoor, and vegetation settings, with aligned collision geometry. Building on these environments, we develop a scene-adaptive pipeline for automated expert flight collection, yielding 94K demonstrations and 46.5M synchronized observation-state-action samples at 50 Hz. We further provide an extensible API that supports training different policy formulations on this shared corpus and evaluating them under unified protocols in the corresponding environments. We benchmark seven baselines spanning four policy paradigms across three navigation settings in seen and unseen environments, and further examine scaling behavior with ACT. Scaling ACT's training corpus from 5 to 70 scenes raises median success rates on seen and unseen environments from 30.6% and 16.8% to 41.2% and 29.4%, respectively. Through this shared training and evaluation framework, AirPlayground supports analysis of how offline prediction errors relate to closed-loop outcomes. Our analyses highlight the roles of prediction errors, execution protocols, and scene interactions in closed-loop performance.

papers.title_en: BoundedGS: Memory-Efficient High-Resolution Training for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Xiaobin Deng, Changyu Diao, Min Li, Duanqing Xu
papers.evidence: 内存高效的高分辨率3D高斯溅射训练
papers.tldr: 高分辨率3D Gaussian Splatting训练会因像素与高斯瓦片相交增多而膨胀光栅化缓存，叠加投影与梯度状态形成显存峰值。BoundedGS解耦光栅化与投影反向传播，按实测负载限制活跃局部工作集，并用候选索引投影和紧凑梯度存储压低视图级峰值。在约6M高斯下，1K至16K渲染工作集稳定在约1.073–1.077 GiB；五个5K室外场景训练显存由9.97降至1.76 GiB，质量相近且训练时间缩短。它为高分辨率3DGS训练提供了可扩展的显存控制方案。
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution 3D Gaussian Splatting training increases pixel and Gaussian-tile intersection counts, expanding rasterization caches that coexist with projection and gradient state at peak memory. A complete-view update aggregates gradients across the view; each region's forward and backward caches can be released after its contribution is collected. BoundedGS separates rasterization and projection backward passes and bounds the active local rasterization working set according to its measured load. Candidate-indexed projection and compact gradient storage address the view-level peaks exposed by this change, while CPU-assisted structure rebuilding and bounded image supply manage resources outside rendering. In a resolution sweep at a fixed count of about 6M Gaussians, the measured rendering working set stays within 1.073-1.077 GiB from 1K to 16K; at 11K, a warm pass takes 19.79 seconds versus 21.76 for full-frame execution. Across five native 5K outdoor scenes, full training reduces the mean rendering working set from 9.97 to 1.76 GiB (82.3%), retains similar reconstruction quality, and shortens training time from 36.7 to 33.9 minutes.   Project page: https://xiaobin2001.github.io/BoundedGS-Web/

papers.title_en: ParetoGS: High-Quality Continuous-Budget 3D Gaussian Splatting with Sparse Adapted Anchors
papers.authors: Xiaobin Deng, Changyu Diao, Min Li, Duanqing Xu
papers.evidence: 跨预算的可扩展三维高斯泼溅场景表示
papers.tldr: 可扩展3D高斯泼溅需用同一场景表示服务不同高斯数量预算，但直接继承高预算参数往往使低预算质量落后。ParetoGS用少量适配预算锚点刻画成员变化与参数演化，通过剪枝与固定成员适配构建嵌套锚点，并用紧凑残差图集编码相对全模型的参数变化。解码时插值共享成员状态并逐步引入新成员渲染贡献，将稀疏锚点连成连续预算表示。在13个场景上，它以更少高斯取得更优平均PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS，并优于FlexGS-imp与NanoGS-imp的部分预算结果。
papers.abstract_en: Scalable 3D Gaussian Splatting allows one scene representation to serve different Gaussian-count budgets, yet its quality-budget curve may lag behind models optimized separately for each budget. Reducing the number of Gaussians changes both the selected members and the reconstruction tasks carried by the survivors; parameters inherited from a high-budget model may fit a low-budget representation poorly. We propose ParetoGS, which describes member changes and parameter evolution with a small set of adapted budget anchors and decodes intermediate budgets without separate optimization at every requested count. ParetoGS alternates pruning and fixed-member adaptation to build nested anchors with persistent identities, and encodes their parameter changes relative to the full model in a compact residual atlas. At decoding, it interpolates the states of shared members and gradually introduces the rendering contributions of new members, connecting sparse anchors into a continuous-budget representation. Across 13 scenes, ParetoGS attains better average PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS with fewer Gaussians than the compared prefix methods at 10% of each method's own full model. From a shared full model, it also outperforms FlexGS-imp at its trained 1%, 5%, and 10% budgets and NanoGS-imp at the 1% and 0.1% budgets. On Garden, its non-anchor quality approaches an empirical reference from independently optimized GNS models at higher retention ratios and exceeds it at some lower-budget points. Across 13 scenes, encoding reduces mean additional state from 390.0 to 85.7 MB with an average PSNR change of 0.01 dB.   Project page: https://xiaobin2001.github.io/ParetoGS-Web/

papers.title_en: DimFlow: Bidirectional Grid-Expert Learning for Dynamic Gaussian Reconstruction
papers.evidence: 动态高斯重建与网格专家场景特征
papers.tldr: 动态高斯重建需紧凑场景特征协调几何与外观变化，但因子化网格仅靠插值难以保证时空属性兼容。DimFlow让多分辨率网格与坐标专家分支双向交互，通过特征对抗对齐、自适应融合和激活掩码残差反馈联合学习。四个属性专家分别建模形变、旋转、不透明度和时序信息。在D-NeRF、HyperNeRF、DAVIS上取得39.73 dB PSNR，较4D-GS提升1.92 dB并保持85 FPS，模型仅18.9 MB。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic Gaussian reconstruction requires compact scene features to support coordinated changes in geometry and appearance. A factorized grid provides efficient local queries, but accurate interpolation alone does not ensure that the resulting dynamic attributes remain compatible across space and time. We introduce DimFlow, a framework that learns these features through bidirectional interaction between a multi-resolution grid and a coordinate-based expert branch. Feature-level adversarial alignment connects their distributions, adaptive fusion transfers complementary information, and activation-masked residual feedback refines the grid during training. Four attribute experts organize deformation, rotation, opacity, and temporal information before Gaussian rendering. In the aggregate comparison across D-NeRF, HyperNeRF, and DAVIS, DimFlow achieves 39.73 dB PSNR, improving on 4D-GS by 1.92 dB while matching its reported 85 FPS rendering speed. The model occupies 18.9 MB, compared with 18.3 MB for 4D-GS. Component and attribute-expert ablations reveal complementary contributions from feature alignment, adaptive exchange, and temporal processing.

papers.title_en: SG^2SLAM: Spatial Geometry-Informed 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Monocular Outdoor Navigation
papers.authors: Ziang Guo, Didar Seyidov, Yixiao Zhou, Xuefeng Zhang, Ali Alridha Abdulkarim, Chen Min, Zufeng Zhang, Dzmitry Tsetserukou
papers.evidence: 基于射线条件化核的3D高斯泼溅SLAM，实现稠密地图与渲染
papers.tldr: 单目户外导航需要鲁棒位姿估计与稠密可导航地图，但现有3DGS SLAM依赖逐帧2D-3D关联，易把跟踪误差累积进地图并引发级联退化。SG^2SLAM将流式空间几何与射线条件3DGS核耦合，以块级度量先验统一监督跟踪与建图，并用视角方向子空间感知单目相机视点。KITTI和Waymo实验表明其优于逐帧关联基线，可联合优化几何与位姿并获得全局一致的地图与轨迹。
papers.abstract_en: Monocular outdoor navigation requires robust camera motion estimation and a dense, navigable map, where 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM serves this task through an explicit differentiable parameterization and closed-form projection. However, typically, the geometry is recovered by associating 2D pixels with 3D points, so a modular SLAM system absorbs tracking error into the map, leading to cascading degradation. To address these gaps, we present SG^2SLAM, which couples streaming spatial geometry with a ray-conditioned 3DGS kernel. Streaming spatial geometry replaces the per- frame cross-dimensional correspondence with a chunk-level metric prior that supervises tracking and mapping from one source. A ray-conditioned kernel extends each primitive with a viewing-direction subspace that senses the monocular camera viewpoints. The joint optimization over spatial geometry and poses ensures a globally consistent map and trajectory outcome. Experiments on the KITTI and Waymo Open datasets show that our SG^2SLAM surpasses the per-frame association baselines in the monocular outdoor navigation task. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

papers.title_en: LingGS: Decoupling Feed-Forward Geometry Prediction from Camera Tracking for High-Fidelity Gaussian SLAM
papers.authors: Da Li, Yihan Zang, Ivan Viola, Zeyu Wang, Dominik Engel
papers.evidence: 高斯SLAM中的流式高斯稠密场景表示
papers.tldr: 单目RGB高斯泼溅SLAM在有限优化预算下难以兼顾高质量重建与响应式跟踪。LingGS将冻结的流式3D基础模型作为虚拟RGB-D传感器，并用显式几何求解器通过特征重投影估计相机运动，再由流式Gaussian建图器融合观测。室内外实验显著提升重建质量，单张RTX 4090约7 FPS，吞吐量为对比SLAM系统的2-3倍。这表明将前馈几何预测与相机跟踪解耦，可提升跟踪精度并增强方法的通用性。
papers.abstract_en: Achieving high-quality reconstruction and responsive camera tracking remains challenging for monocular RGB Gaussian splatting SLAM under a limited optimization budget. We present an online system that addresses this challenge by combining learned geometric priors with explicit geometric camera tracking, which can substantially outperform learned camera prediction in terms of tracking accuracy. A frozen streaming 3D foundation model serves as a virtual RGB-D sensor, providing depth estimation from monocular video. An explicit geometric solver then estimates camera motion through feature reprojection, and a streaming Gaussian mapper integrates the resulting observations into a dense scene representation. We further show that geometric tracking improves camera pose accuracy across representative streaming geometry backbones, demonstrating the broader applicability of our approach. Extensive experiments on indoor and outdoor datasets show that our method significantly improves reconstruction quality over existing approaches, achieving about 7 FPS on a single RTX 4090 and delivering 2-3 times the throughput of the evaluated prior SLAM systems.
